thought.text: Now let me verify the example dev server starts and is reachable.

reasoning_content:
Now let me test that the example app starts. The guide says `npm run start:example` which runs build then cd example && npm install && npm run dev. Let me verify the dev server starts, and also verify the package can be imported/consumed.

Let me start the dev server in background and curl.

action.command: cd /workspace/example && (npm run dev > /tmp/example_dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 8; cat /tmp/example_dev.log; echo "---CURL---"; curl -s -o /tmp/index.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/ ; head -20 /tmp/index.html
